seo.title: Start a Confidential Conversation
seo.description: Discuss an investment, market entry, joint venture, digital transformation or AI opportunity with Ibn Sina Ventures. Every enquiry is treated confidentially.

label: Contact
title: Start a conversation.
lead: Tell us briefly what you are evaluating or building. Share only what you are comfortable with — we can sign an NDA before going into detail.

steps.name: Share the outline
steps.text: A few lines on the opportunity, the market and what you need.

steps.name: Introductory call
steps.text: We review it and arrange a conversation, under NDA where needed.

steps.name: Scope & model
steps.text: We propose a scope, a team and the right commercial model.

privacy: Your enquiry is read only by the Ibn Sina Ventures team and is never shared without your consent. We use your details solely to respond. See our privacy notice.

success.title: Thank you.
success.text: Your enquiry has been received and will be treated confidentially. We will be in touch to arrange an introductory conversation.

error: We could not send your enquiry just now. Please try again in a moment.
